verdict.rationale: Vercel's own homepage claims you can "Secure every internal agent, app, and deployment with your identity provider," which matches the story's subject directly. That claim is a single marketing line with no documentation of how it works. The separate Deployment Protection doc (Vercel Authentication, passwords, trusted IPs) is an adjacent access control and does not show organization IdP integration. Missing for 10: documentation of supported IdPs and protocols (SAML/OIDC/SCIM), setup steps for protecting internal apps and agents, plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider
